description: Create an EMPTY menu on a business the caller manages (add sections with add_category, dishes with add_item). For a whole menu at once, use create_full_menu instead. Returns the new menu_id.

id.description: Optional caller-chosen id (8-64 chars). Reuse the same id when retrying so a retry can never create a duplicate.

is_active.description: Whether the menu is live on the public site

name: create_menu
title: Create menu
